purpose: blind incremental Specular run (Generation, Validation, Model Checking, Reproduction)
prior_suite: /work/previous/.specular-output (immutable; V0 artifacts archived under spec/v0-archive, spec/cfg-archive-v0, spec/output/v0-prior, traces/archived-v0)

commands.harness: harness/run.sh [--no-prepare] [scenario...]  (600 s outer timeout per scenario, 1200 s build)
commands.trace_validation: spec/trace-both.sh <scenario>  (TLC Trace.cfg + Trace-witness.cfg, 1800 s outer timeout, -workers 1)
commands.model_checking: spec/campaign.sh <name> <module> <cfg> <workers> <heap> [-simulate -depth N]  (1800 s outer timeout; states under /dev/shm/specular-e2e-case-002/<name>, removed after each run)
commands.reproduction: harness/repro/test_bug*.sh -> harness/repro.sh <label> <selector> both (900 s outer timeout per tree)

limits: 30-minute TLC budget per run; no exhaustive result claimed (LIMITED_COVERAGE)
Level 1 timing assistance in MC-1/MC-2 reproductions
